# Bounded Multiscale Calibration Evidence

`cases.json` defines seven fictional candidate households, linked fictional
person rows, and distinct CSD, CT, ADA, and DA target cases. Official 2021
Statistics Canada identifiers are used only to test geography identity and
resource-column handling.

`evidence.json` is generated by
`scripts/build_multiscale_validation_evidence.py`. The script runs the real
linked fitter, deterministic integerization, and an independent vectorized
read-back of every household and linked-person target cell. Two DA target cases
sum to the bounded CSD target case and their fitted and integerized cell counts
are checked for reconciliation.

The targets do not describe the real geographies. In particular, the two DAs
do not exhaust the Montréal CSD. Zero targets are declared software-test
constraints, not claims of structural impossibility in Census data. Nothing in
this fixture supports national coverage, local representativeness, or
population-quality claims.
